mapper.sql: id, namespace, config_key, version, content, content_md5, sensitive, publisher, note, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mcp_config_snapshot (namespace, config_key, version, content, content_md5, sensitive, publisher, note, status, update_time) VALUES (#{namespace}, #{configKey}, #{version}, #{content}, #{contentMd5}, #{sensitive}, #{publisher}, #{note}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE mcp_config_snapshot SET content = #{content}, content_md5 = #{contentMd5}, sensitive = #{sensitive}, publisher = #{publisher}, note = #{note}, status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM mcp_config_snapshot WHERE namespace = #{namespace} AND config_key = #{configKey} ORDER BY version
SELECT FROM mcp_config_snapshot WHERE namespace = #{namespace} ORDER BY config_key, version
SELECT FROM mcp_config_snapshot ORDER BY namespace, config_key, version
